# Mnemonic disagreeing with the filename

`Policy: pol-DEVI` `DRAFT`

## Purpose

A well-formed mnemonic that names a different policy than the file it sits in.

## Scope

This fixture only.

## Clauses

| Id      | Clause                                                  | Alignment |
|---------|---------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `CLEAN` | **MUST** trigger `id-matches-filename` and nothing else |           |
